findings.summary: The review dialog's close control is a div with onClick around a Close icon: no button role, no name, not focusable, so screen reader users meet an unlabelled image (Escape still closes).
findings.fix: Replace the div with the pattern Dialogs.jsx:285 already uses: <Button aria-label={t('modal.cancel')} icon={<Close/>} variant="ghost" size="small" onClick={onClose}/>. Keep it a button, not a link: it performs an action.

findings.summary: The Metatype property picker's close control is a div with onClick around a Close icon: no role, no accessible name and not reachable by Tab (Escape still closes).
findings.fix: Use <Button aria-label={t('modal.cancel')} icon={<Close/>} variant="ghost" size="small" onClick={onClose}/>, as in Dialogs.jsx:285.

findings.summary: CreateOptionCard, the selectable template/factory card of the create dialog, is a div with onClick: not focusable, no role, selected state shown only by styling, so keyboard and screen reader users cannot pick a template.
findings.fix: Render each card as a native choice: <label> wrapping <input type="radio" name="create-template" checked={isSelected} onChange={onClick}/> plus the texts, inside a <fieldset> whose <legend> is the section title (modal.create.templateLabel / factoryLabel). Alternatively <button type="button" aria-pressed={isSelected}>. Not a link: it selects, it does not navigate.

findings.summary: Each file entry is a table row with onClick that loads the file: exposed as a plain row, Enter/Space on the focused row do nothing, and the current file is marked only by the isHighlighted class.
findings.fix: Selecting a file does not change the URL, so use button semantics, not a link: render the list as <ul> with one <button type="button" aria-current={isSelected ? 'true' : undefined}> per file, or a role="listbox" with role="option" aria-selected items driven by the existing ArrowUp/ArrowDown handler (FileSidebar.jsx:77). Use <a href> only if file selection gets its own route.
findings.evidence: <TableRow ... isHighlighted={selectedFile?.name === f.name} onClick={() => handleFileClick(f)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>

findings.summary: The raw editor leaves Monaco's link detection on (links defaults to true), so URLs inside configuration values become Ctrl/Cmd+click links that open a new window without warning and are not exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Add links: false to the monaco.editor.create options: configuration values are data to edit, not navigation. If following URLs is wanted, keep it and document the new-window behaviour in the editor help text. Recommendation only (AAA, beyond the AA target).
findings.evidence: monaco.editor.create(containerRef.current, { value, language, ... lineNumbers: 'on', glyphMargin: true, folding: true, ... }) - no links option

passed: No <a> element is rendered anywhere in scope: Editor.jsx, CfgEditor.jsx and FileSidebar.jsx contain no anchors or hrefs (their grep hits were table markup).
No href="#", javascript: URL, or anchor used as a button.
No target="_blank", window.open or other new-tab navigation in application code.

The only anchor is the detached download anchor built in index.jsx:98-107 (href to a blob URL, download=file.name), clicked programmatically and removed; the user-facing trigger is a real Button labelled Download (SelectedFileToolbar.jsx:85-89) next to the selected file's name.
No ambiguous link text (click here, read more, learn more, here) and no raw URL used as link text, in JSX or in locales/en.json.
No repeated identical link texts pointing to different destinations, and no adjacent icon + text link duplicates.
Label in name (2.5.3): the Metatype option buttons (CfgMetatypePropertyDialog.jsx:149-153) use aria-label={property.id}, which matches their visible bold label.

Actions are buttons: modal close (Dialogs.jsx:285), Metatype options (CfgMetatypePropertyDialog.jsx:149), reorder handle (CfgEditor.jsx:608), toolbar actions (SelectedFileToolbar.jsx, MonacoEditor.jsx:1355-1412).
useDialogA11y.ts:4 includes a[href] in its focusable selector, so a future link inside a dialog stays inside the focus trap.
notes: Premise correction: the task said FileSidebar.jsx, Editor.jsx and CfgEditor.jsx contain anchors/hrefs. They do not. The clickable non-button elements found instead are reported above as LINK-CONTROL-ELEMENT.

The YAML editor's collapsible container row (Editor.jsx:161-171, onClick on a td) and the double-click-to-edit value (Editor.jsx:105) are also non-button controls. They are reported by tables-data-specialist (they are table cells), not repeated here.

Repeated identical button names without row context (Delete this property, Reorder this entry, Insert) are not link text under 2.4.4 and are reported by tables-data-specialist as cell-control context.
Runtime check left to the browser half: confirm Monaco's link hover ('Follow link') appears on a value containing http(s):// at the page URL.
